scripts.test: npm run bundle && tsc --noEmit && node --test tests/
scripts.deploy:grove: node scripts/secrets.ts pull && npm run bundle && (cd grove && neon deploy --env ../.env.grove --project-id snowy-hat-06906890 --branch main --update-existing); rm -f grove/.gitignore grove/.env.local
scripts.deploy:edge: node scripts/secrets.ts pull && (set -a; . ./.env.grove; set +a; printf 'EDGE_SECRET=%s\n' "$EDGE_SECRET" > edge/.env.secrets; (cd edge && cf deploy --secrets-file .env.secrets); rm -f edge/.env.secrets)
scripts.deploy:runner: node scripts/secrets.ts pull && IMG=us-east5-docker.pkg.dev/makewithgrove/cloud-run-source-deploy/grove-runner:$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && (cd runner && gcloud builds submit --project makewithgrove --tag $IMG --quiet) && gcloud run deploy grove-sandbox --project makewithgrove --region us-east5 --image $IMG --command node --args dist/boxes.mjs --quiet && gcloud run deploy grove-runner --project makewithgrove --region us-east5 --image $IMG --quiet
scripts.test:runner: docker rm -f grove-spike-pg >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name grove-spike-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=spike -p 54329:5432 postgres:17 >/dev/null && sleep 6 && (cd runner && node pack.mjs && RUNNER_ENTRY=dist/server.mjs node --experimental-strip-types trial.mjs local); docker rm -f grove-spike-pg >/dev/null
scripts.test:live:runner: (set -a; . ./.env.grove; set +a; cd runner && node --experimental-strip-types trial.mjs live runnertrial $APPS_DOMAIN)
